Bloodwood trees typically yield a very small number of logs, with each log gained having a 25% chance to fell the tree. Initially, the player has only access to 3 trees, all of them located in the [[Wilderness]]. The remaining five are not located in the Wilderness, but are also locked behind a quest or some other requirement. Without any modifiers, each bloodwood tree provides an average of 4 logs before it's felled.
The chance to successfully chop is affected by the [[Hatchets|hatchet]] used and Woodcutting level of the player; better hatchets and a higher Woodcutting level increases the likelihood of successfully receiving a log.
Using a high-quality [[Hatchets|hatchet]] with the [[Honed]] perk, along with the [[nature's sentinel outfit]] increase the rate at which logs are gathered{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Pi |url=https://twitter.com/JagexPi/status/959009542041370630|date=1 February 2018|quote=Using aura and using augmented axe with honed5/refined2 will help increase your chances. After that you'll need to wait until natures sentinel is available in game.|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98125|archivedate=11 February 2020}}, but also cause the tree to fell faster. Burning [[bloodweed incense sticks]] gives a chance of doubling a bloodwood log, up to 10%, and using a hatchet with the [[Refined]] perk will increase the logs per tree.
With the tier 5 [[Infernal Puzzle Box]] in the [[backpack]] or [[tool belt]], trees get more difficult to fell, decreasing the chance from 25% to approximately 5% for an average of 20 logs per tree. The tier 5 Infernal Puzzle Box unlock can be obtained by completing the [[Civil War III (miniquest)|Civil War III]] miniquest. Tier 6 allows the player to add the puzzle box to their [[tool belt]], resulting in the effect being active at all times.
The [[Fletching cape]] can also rarely increase the number of bolts produced. Equipping a [[Sana's fyrtorch]] and using a [[perfect juju woodcutting potion]] will provide a chance of receiving an extra log. Temporary buffs that directly affect the [[Woodcutting]] level, such as the Gatherer skills boost from an [[advanced pulse core]], can also significantly boost the rate at which logs are obtained.
